title: feat(digital-factory-ui-bugfix/T3): feature/card/status rendering fixes
body:
## T3 — Feature/card/status rendering fixes

### Changes
- **Task-mode feature lifecycle status**: Enriched backend task search results with real feature lifecycle status from already-loaded features, so task-mode feature rows show the actual feature status (e.g., "In Progress") instead of a task-derived proxy.
- **Feature mode card status-pill suppression**: Removed the status pill from Feature mode cards. Status is represented by the kanban-style status column/cell, not a card badge.
- **Feature mode card title/ID hierarchy**: Title is now the primary text area (wraps via `line-clamp-2`), while the feature ID is rendered as smaller secondary text below. Long titles get priority width.
- **Task tab repository as plain text**: Repository metadata is now rendered as plain text instead of a hyperlink.
- **Tests**: Added 12 focused render tests covering lifecycle status display, card hierarchy, status-pill suppression, and repository text.

### Files changed
- `src/features/board/components/TaskBoardView/TaskBoardView.tsx` — enrich backend task results with feature lifecycle status
- `src/features/board/components/FeatureBoardView/FeatureListRow.tsx` — suppress status pill, swap title/ID hierarchy
- `src/features/tasks/components/TaskTabView/TaskTabView.tsx` — repository as plain text
- `src/__tests__/t3-rendering-fixes.test.ts` — new focused render tests
- `src/__tests__/t5-regression.test.ts` — update status-pill test
- `src/__tests__/task-tab-view.test.ts` — update repo-link test
